title: Learning without Overwriting: A Theory of Self-Distillation and Supervised Fine-Tuning in Continual Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.05200v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) of large language models (LLMs) has demonstrated the ability to improve reasoning capabilities while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Despite substantial empirical success, the dynamics of OPSD in continual reasoning remain incompletely understood. Modeling LLM reasoning as search over a directed acyclic graph, we provide a unified theoretical analysis of both the dynamics of post-training---OPSD and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) in continual learning---and the impact of pre-training on subsequent performance. Our findings establish three key insights with an optimization guarantee: (i) OPSD with hints from correct outputs enables continual learning without forgetting by sparse yet effective gradient descent updates induced by the hint structure. translated_title: 无覆盖学习：持续推理中的自蒸馏与监督微调理论
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）的在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）已被证明能够在保持先前已获取知识的同时提升推理能力。尽管在实证上取得了显著成功，但OPSD在持续推理中的动态机制仍未被充分理解。通过将LLM推理建模为在有向无环图上的搜索，本文对训练后阶段的动态（即持续学习中的OPSD和监督微调SFT）以及预训练对后续性能的影响提供了统一的理论分析。研究发现建立了三个具有优化保证的关键洞察：（i）基于正确输出提示的OPSD通过提示结构所诱导的稀疏而有效的梯度下降更新，实现了无遗忘的持续学习；（ii）对正确推理路径进行SFT可能会因沿训练路径的密集更新覆盖已有信息而导致灾难性遗忘。
tldr: 本文将有向无环图上的搜索作为LLM推理的理论模型，证明了在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）通过提示结构诱导的稀疏梯度更新能够实现无遗忘的持续推理学习，而监督微调（SFT）因沿训练路径的密集更新覆盖已有知识而导致灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: This paper models LLM reasoning as search over a directed acyclic graph and theoretically proves that on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) enables continual learning without forgetting through sparse yet effective gradient updates induced by hint structures, while supervised fine-tuning (SFT) causes catastrophic forgetting due to dense updates that overwrite existing knowledge.
